claim: One CPU render repeated byte-for-byte in one locked environment; this is not yet a canonical corpus or cross-version qualification.
known_limitations: Only one sound identity was rendered.
Only one host/runtime combination was tested.
The selected runtime has not been compared with a paper-era PyTorch runtime.
Named internal traces were not captured.
The generated audio artifacts remain local and are not committed.
packaging_observation: A normal Git dependency checkout failed because an upstream documentation LFS object is missing. The dependency was changed to a commit-addressed source archive; the adapter independently verifies all runtime Voice file hashes.
